Versus 1. State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp 2. Ranveer Kumar Mahiya, Properietor Mahiya Akshay Ujala  Private Limited Aadsar Tehsil Sridungarpur Dist. Bikaner  ----Respondents For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Achala Ram

For Respondent(s) : Mr. Arun Kumar, PP  Mr. Rakesh Jakhar  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MANOJ KUMAR GARG Order 21/07/2023 The instant criminal misc. petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the petitioners for quashing the criminal proceedings arising out of FIR No.176/2023 registered at Police Station Sri Dungargarh, District Bikaner for offences under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 and 406 of IPC on the basis of compromise entered between the parties.

entities.text: Police Station Sri Dungargarh, District Bikaner
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Counsel for the petitioners submits that the matter has already been compromised between the parties and it is borne out from the compromise that respondent No.2 is not inclined to proceed further in the matter.
Counsel has placed reliance on a decision of Supreme Court in the case of Gian Singh Vs. State [2023:RJ-JD:22718] (2 of 2) [CRLMP-3998/2023] of Punjab & Anr. [(2012) 10 SCC 303].

entities.text: Gian Singh Vs. State [2023:RJ-JD:22718] (2 of 2) [CRLMP-3998/2023] of Punjab & Anr. [(2012) 10 SCC 303]
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In these circumstances, the impugned FIR and all consequential proceedings may be quashed on the basis of compromise.
Counsel for the respondent No.2 concurs the fact of compromise and submits that in view of the compromise, the respondent No.2 does not want to proceed further in the matter.

Kapil vs State Of Rajasthan (2023:Rj-Jd:22718) on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/13583967/
1

In view of compromise arrived at between the parties and applying the ratio in decision of Gian Singh (Supra), I deem it just and proper to invoke inherent powers of this Court under Section 482 Cr.P.C.

Accordingly, the present misc. petition is allowed qua the petitioners and criminal proceedings arising out of FIR No.176/2023 registered at Police Station Sri Dungargarh, District Bikaner for offences under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 and 406 of IPC are hereby quashed on the basis of compromise deed.
Stay petition also stands disposed of.
(MANOJ KUMAR GARG),J 82-Rashi/-
